content.text: Almost. Health Canada's guidance is to start around 6 months, so Theo is about a month out. Until then, breast milk or formula is all he needs. For now, watch for readiness. Can he sit with support, hold his head steady, and lean in or open his mouth when you eat? Letting him sit in on your meals is a good way to see it. As always, confirm timing with your provider or public health.
